work.title: Untitled (Collage with Target)
work.description: Framed mixed-media collage on white ground combining a bold bullseye target, compact disc, vinyl record, and vertical orange stripe elements across a horizontal composition. Scattered mechanical fragments, numerals, and black-and-white photographic scraps populate the lower register amid green and ochre accents.
work.composition: horizontal scatter with central target anchor
keywords: vinyl disc and concentric rings composition
